# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native, portrait-first mobile canvas game titled **MJOLNIR RINGFIRE: Covenant Breach**. Preserve the mechanics of a center-defense survival shooter: the player holds touch/drag to aim a central super-soldier turret, auto-fires at enemies spawning from the edges, protects a six-segment shield wall, gains resource from kills, and drags support cards onto center or perimeter zones to activate upgrades. Reinterpret the loop as a Halo-inspired military sci-fi arena siege on a ringworld. Use a clean futuristic HUD, blue shield energy, green Spartan armor, gold visor, purple alien raiders, distant dropships, shield/requisition bars, heroic orchestral sci-fi audio from approved catalogs, and touch-friendly portrait UI for 4:7 to 9:16 aspect ratios.

Primary steering prompt: Halo sci-fi arena shooter. A Halo sci-fi arena shooter with super-soldier combat, alien war, vehicle battles, heroic scale, clean military futurism, shield-based firefights, and epic orchestral grandeur with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile portrait canvas survival defense shooter with drag-to-aim auto-fire and drag-and-drop support cards.
- objective: Keep a central defender alive while hostile units spawn from arena edges, move inward, damage a six-segment perimeter shield, and eventually attack the core if they breach.
- input model: Start/restart buttons use native click/tap; active play uses pointer down/move on the canvas to aim and fire; support cards in the bottom dock use pointer drag and drop onto center or perimeter zones.
- core loop: Aim from the center, fire projectiles, destroy incoming raiders, gain requisition, spawn up to three cards, drag cards to valid zones, repair or upgrade defenses, survive escalating tiers.
- fail/friction state: Shield wall segments can be depleted; if enemies reach the Spartan and reduce shield/HP to zero, the game enters a game-over screen with final score and restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas resize, requestAnimationFrame loop, center-locked hero, pointer aim/fire semantics, projectile speed/lifetime/damage, enemy spawn cadence scaling, enemy movement toward center, six-segment barricade collision/HP, score increment per kill, tier increase every 50 kills, requisition card spawning at 100 resource, maximum three cards, drop-zone validation radii, card effects, game-over/restart flow.

## Remixed target
MJOLNIR RINGFIRE reframes the same protected survival-defense mechanics as a Halo-like mobile sci-fi arena siege: an armored super-soldier holds a ringworld gate against purple alien raiders, manages shield barricades, calls armor-core and perimeter ordnance cards, and survives escalating warzone tiers. Presentation is regenerated through military-futurist HUD copy, procedural ringworld background, Spartan focal silhouette, alien raider forms, approved sci-fi/heroic audio, and portrait-readable touch controls while preserving the source loop.
